source.author: verg
source.text: sanguine Troiano et Rutulo dotabere, virgo, et Bellona manet te pronuba.
source.text_original: sanguine Troiano et Rutulo dotabere, virgo, / et Bellona manet te pronuba.
source.text_english: With Trojan and Rutulian blood you will be endowed, maiden, and Bellona awaits you as your bridal attendant.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: via facta per undas perque hiemes, Bellona, tibi.
reuse.text_original: via facta per undas / perque hiemes, Bellona, tibi.
reuse.text_english: a road made through the waves and through the winters, O Bellona, for you.
